general.description: Configures the merchant credentials of the platform for every payment provider (Alipay, WeChat Pay, ...) and the channels each provider offers to apps.
general.emptyState: There is no payment provider to configure.

provider.cardSubtitle: The credentials are issued by the payment provider and shared by all of its channels. They are never echoed back, the form only reports whether a value is stored.
provider.enabledHelpText: Apps that pay with the platform credentials can only collect through this provider once it is enabled.
provider.resetModalMessage: Clear all credentials of “{name}”? Apps that pay with the platform credentials will no longer be able to collect through this provider.
provider.hint: The credentials are encrypted on the server and never echoed back - an empty input keeps the stored value. Every required field has to be filled before the provider can be enabled.

channels.title: Payment channels
channels.subtitle: A channel is one way of paying that the provider offers. A channel that is switched off here cannot be enabled by any app.

channel.enabledHelpText: Once switched off, no app can collect through this channel anymore.
channel.resetModalMessage: Clear the parameters of “{name}”? The channel will no longer be offered to any app.
channel.runtimeHint: When paying through this channel the app also has to hand in the runtime parameters: {params}.

notification.saveSuccess: The payment provider settings have been saved.
notification.resetSuccess: The payment provider configuration has been cleared.
notification.missingFields: “{name}” is enabled, please fill in every required field first.
